title: ph-privacy-guide evaluation question
description: One row of eval/questions/{train,dev,test}.jsonl. Enforced by ph_privacy_guide.evaluate.questions. See eval/GUIDELINES.md.

answerable.description: False for out_of_scope and not_covered, and only for those.

gold.description: Instrument key plus section path, such as NPC_Circular_2022-04 s.7. A hit on any chunk of that section counts. Empty if and only if answerable is false.

gold_doc_ids.description: Filled in from gold on import.

source.description: rule = generated by code from headings or definitions; train split only.

origin.description: Empty only when source is rule. The test split may contain only human.

reviewer.description: Required for dev and test, and for any ai_draft_edited row.

pair_id.description: Links translations and paraphrases. A pair may not cross splits.
